domain_description: Well planning, mud engineering, directional drilling, casing design, cementing, drill string design, bit selection, drilling hydraulics, well control, logging analysis, formation evaluation, stuck pipe prevention, torque and drag modeling, rig selection, and drilling optimization for upstream oil and gas operations. Based on API standards, IADC guidelines, and SPE technical literature.
authority_sources: API RP 65 Part 2 (Isolating Potential Flow Zones)

engines.name: Well Planning Engine
engines.function: Plan well trajectories, casing programs, mud programs, and drilling schedules for vertical, deviated, and horizontal wells considering formation pressures, geological hazards, and regulatory requirements.
doctrine_topics: well trajectory design (vertical, S-curve, J-curve, horizontal)
casing program design and setting depth selection
pore pressure and fracture gradient prediction
well construction timeline and cost estimation
geological hazard identification and mitigation
regulatory permit requirements (state and federal)
anti-collision analysis for pad drilling
kick tolerance calculations
well control contingency planning
offset well analysis and lessons learned

golden_queries.question: Plan a horizontal well in the Wolfcamp A formation at 8,500 ft TVD with a 10,000 ft lateral, designing the casing program, mud weights, and trajectory considering a 500 psi depleted zone at 7,200 ft
required_elements: trajectory design with KOP and landing point
casing program with sizes and setting depths

golden_queries.question: How do you design a well plan for a 6-well pad in the Permian Basin with minimum slot spacing and anti-collision requirements?
